policy.engineDifferences: Xyce CSV .print vs ngspice -r output.raw and ascii .spiceinit only
policy.counts: success requires every projected analysis to export numeric data; unsupported circuit still gets an ngspice diagnostic run on canonical bytes
policy.comparisons: All projected analyses must succeed in both engines; any reference warning of ignored/unsupported semantics excludes the fixture. Signal selection is native ngspice v()/i() names, not numeric outcome.
policy.fallbackSignals: If ngspice fails to export, Xyce is requested v(0) only; never compared.
policy.timing: single run including startup/output, not a speed benchmark
